meta.name: Bonyo Premer Golpo
meta.description:
A story about how far a person can go in love?? How could something as beautiful as love, shape something as ugly as murder? Bonyo Premer Golpo a thriller story that brings you the wilder side of love.

Returning Series · First aired 23 Jan 2020 · India · Language: Bengali · 30 min
Studio: Acropoliis  Entertainment · Network: hoichoi

Complete series. On your server: S1 7/7 | S2 10/10

On your server — Audio: Bengali

videos.title: Majhraater Call
videos.overview: A midnight call reveals that three murderers have escaped from the jail. Is Mrinalini going to be the next victim of a ruthless murderer?

videos.title: Khali Parking Lot
videos.overview: Amidst the media's attention, Minnie helps Officer Subrata in tracking the fugitive, Shafiq. But, are the murderers after Minnie's loved ones, too?

videos.title: Amar Bhabhijaan
videos.overview: Minnie reveals to the police how Shafiq turned into a murderer because of failed love. Will she unwittingly cause danger of someone she loves?

videos.title: Mukh, Mukhosh, O Mrittu
videos.overview: Officer Subrata warns the citizens against the murderers on the loose. Meanwhile, will one of them finally be able to hurt Minnie?

videos.title: Bidishar Nesha
videos.overview: Minnie meets the family of the victim of Gaurav, one of the escaped murderers. What will she find about his decent life before becoming a criminal?

videos.title: Shedin Dekha Hoyechilo
videos.overview: Minnie finally manages to contact Gaurav and decides to meet him alone. Will the truth she discovers help her with the case - or shatter her completely?

videos.title: Onyo Premer Golpo
videos.overview: Armed with new evidence, the police finally make a shocking arrest. But, is the real criminal behind bars - or is Minnie still in grave danger?

videos.title: Dead Man Crawling
videos.overview: Dr. Kanishka Rakshit joins an asylum as a resident doctor. Little does he know what happens here after the midnight hour.

videos.title: Her Bloody Footprints
videos.overview: Minnie is the primary suspect of the former doctor's murder. But why is Jharna tiptoeing around bloody footprints?

videos.title: The Invisible Friend
videos.overview: Minnie has a new friend. But no one knows if she is hallucinatory or real. Jharna is revealed to have a miscarriage.

videos.title: The Pink Door
videos.overview: A sex-racket creates further turmoil in the asylum. Minnie is missing, as Kanishka finds out the truth about Jharna's miscarriage.

videos.title: The Faceless Nurse
videos.overview: Jharna starts speaking again. Kanishka has an admier who is ready to kill for him.

videos.title: The Scarlet Kiss
videos.overview: Kanishka and Binapani investigates Swati's murder. The reality of Minnie's friend is revealed.

videos.title: The Whistling Lullaby
videos.overview: The asylum is under the attack of goons. Can Kanishka save the day?

videos.title: The Unsatisfied Wife
videos.overview: Minnie reveals her deepest secrets to Kanishka and requests him to hypnotise her.

videos.title: The Unfantastic Four
videos.overview: Binapani moves forward with a team to crack the sex-trafficking case. Minnie learns a truth about her past that shatters her.

videos.title: Bus No. 12
videos.overview: Kanishka unearths a shocking secret from Minnie's hypnosis history. Someone is coming back with revenge.
